stage: CPU preparation complete; no LLM inference requested by this script, GPU budget awaits root schedule.
hypothesis: Among already detected, nonnegated, nonoverlapping GLiNER spans rejected by fixed surface-only Sap thresholds, short contextual selection among five distinct HPO concepts can recover correct additional entities at acceptable precision.

baseline.preserve: All original CRF+Sap+26 accepted GLiNER entities and associations remain unchanged.

retrieval.reconstruction: No fitting and no new vectors; actual original per-document GLiNER Sap vectors and original folded bank read only.

prompt_policy.NO_NIL: ABSTAIN covers nonphenotype, negated/normal, uncertainty or no equivalent top5 candidate; it adds nothing and does not prove HPO lacks a concept. No new -1 entity in this fixed control. Existing NIL preserved.

proposed_inference.format: strict entire JSON object with only choice key and one of six codes; invalid/truncated response recorded as failure and no addition; no resampling or answer repair

proposed_cost.estimated_gpu_minutes: 2–5 plus loading; estimate only, actual per-request timing must be measured

planned_output: For valid C1..C5 add the exact original span with mapped HPO; resolve overlaps among accepted spans by original GLiNER score desc,length desc,offset asc; preserve entire base and union only original rules assignments from new accepted evidence. One fixed control, not another threshold/order sweep.
differences_vs_old8B_linking: Input from supervised train48 GLiNER, not LLM quote extraction with many candidate-span false positives.
Pure Sap top5 distinct atomic HPO; old linker mixed char top8 and Sap top8, exact-alias bypass; no new exact bypass.
One span/context with ontology name and bounded definition; old prompt batched up to18 items with name/alias and shorter context.
C1..C5 or ABSTAIN strict choice; old emitted raw HPO/semicolon multiple IDs and -1, with actual invalid/out-of-list responses.
Qwen3.5-9B instead of Qwen3-8B; multiple design differences mean no isolated causal claim about model size.
success_criterion: Positive fixed outerfold0 v2 Score delta versus full frozen .721504 baseline with valid coordinates/HPO and explicit incremental entity/relation TP-FP, after freezing prediction; otherwise close this policy without threshold scan. No originaldev evaluation in this proposal.
